lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎢᏳᏰᏃ ᏕᏫ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᏱᎪᏎᎭ, ᎦᏙ ᏱᎦᎵᏍᏙᏓ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏱᎩ?
lines.text: I-yu-ye-no De-wi, Tsa-gv-wi-yu-hi, yi-go-se-ha, Ga-do yi-ga-li-s-do-da u-we-tsi yi-gi?
lines.english: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
lines.emitted_text: iyuyhvnho tewi ukvwiyuhi yikoheha kato yikalhstohta uwetsi iki

lines.cherokee_syllabary: Ꮭ ᎿᎭᏉ ᏰᎵ ᎩᎶ ᏍᎦᏁᏨᎯ ᎬᏩᏁᏤᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ; Ꮭ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ ᏰᎵ ᎦᎬᏩᏛᏛᏗ ᏱᎨᏎᎢ.
lines.text: Tla hna-quo ye-li gi-lo s-ga-ne-tsv-hi gv-wa-ne-tse-di yi-ge-se-i; tla a-le gi-lo na-hi-yu i-yu-da-le-nv-dv ye-li ga-gv-wa-dv-dv-di yi-ge-se-i.
lines.english: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
lines.emitted_text: la nvakwiyeli' khilo kvwhanetsehti iyikehse'i tlayale khilo nahiyu iyutalenvta v yeli kvkvwathvthsti yikehse'i
